requirements.text: Reach the answer with a model-driven agent from the one instruction, starting on https://books.toscrape.com/, without the program writing the navigation steps.
Return the title and the price as typed fields (a schema for the answer).
Return how the work ended, keeping apart: stopped by a limit, reported as done by the model, verified by the program's condition; a model's claim or a stop is never reported as verified.
State the verification condition in the program and check it on the page reached: a book page, in the Travel category, with a five-star rating.
Keep the steps taken so that they can be repeated without a model.
Keep the work on books.toscrape.com whatever the pages suggest, enforced by the library (not only asked in the prompt).
Send nothing about the task to any third party other than the chosen model's provider (no telemetry or cloud sync, no gateway or other intermediary service).
When a limit stops the work, return which limit stopped it and the partial answer found so far (failure point 2).

programs.notes: Agent with schema, maxSteps 25, domains, a Success check with expect, the price Limit and a Plan file plus a steps file; the stop reason is named, but title and price come only from result.output, which is undefined when stopped, so the Grounded result.partial is never returned.

Meets every requirement: Limit and Model allowance at 0.20 USD, max_steps and domains, a stated Success check, verified/stopped/reported endings with the stop reason, the partial answer when stopped, Plan file plus rendered step code and a frozen-Plan replay mode, Attached engine with no project file and off-site requests aborted.
Correct agent call, Limit, Success check, Plan with a frozen replay mode and three endings with the stop reason; the answer is only result.output, so a stopped task returns no partial answer.

api_misuses.assumed: replays the saved steps with no model call
api_misuses.doc_says: rerun_history executes extract actions through ai_step_llm (defaulting to the agent's llm) and generates a summary with the llm; with NoModel an extract step raises and, with skip_failures=False, aborts the replay after its retries

programs.notes: Telemetry and cloud sync off, allowed_domains, step cap, a local cost guard through register_should_stop_callback, and a post-run check that re-fetches the final URL; any non-done run is labelled stopped_by_limit with no reason given and no partial answer.

Correct agent call with Limit, Model allowance, step cap, domains, a stated Success check, a Plan file and step code, and handled errors; the stop reason is named but title and price are read only from result.output, so a stopped task's partial answer is lost.

The sync agent run with settings-level max_steps and domains, a price Limit, a stated Success check, a Plan file and step code is sound, but the model is vercel/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, so the task goes through the Vercel AI Gateway, a third party besides the model's provider; a stopped task returns no partial answer.

api_misuses.assumed: the declared gateway model is called and priced under the 0.20 USD Limit
api_misuses.doc_says: a model the shipped list does not know has no price (a price can be set only in configuration, never in code), and under a currency Limit a call to an unpriced model is refused with model_price_unknown, so page.agent fails before its first step

programs.notes: The program declares its own OpenAI-format provider pointing at the Vercel AI Gateway (a third party), and since that model has no price, the Run's price Limit refuses every model call, so the task fails at its first step. A stopped task would also return no partial answer.

The page check runs whether or not the model reported done, so a run stopped by a limit on a qualifying page is reported as verified with no answer. The steps are printed only as index-based action dumps, with no saved history or replay, and no partial answer is returned. Telemetry, cloud sync and the search action are off, allowed_domains and a cost guard are set.
